GET /stats accepts ids, fields JSON, KST timeRange JSON and allDays. SummaryStatResponse.data contains SummaryStatMap id/impCnt/clkCnt/salesAmt; validate this documented selected response. Report Swagger version 1.0 is metadata; live wire envelope remains untested.
Dynamic per-customer throttling without fixed QPS. Use own/delegated account keys; advertisers must not hand keys to third parties.

Entity GETs return IDs, customer, parent, pause and submitted controls. Ad.ad is JSON text; SITE channel GET identifies channelTp/customer. Keyword CPC is 70–100000 KRW. Dates require KST midnight. Readback checks explicit locks, budgets, dates, content and parentage.

sources.quote: The type of adgroup system bidding.
sources.fact: Adgroup and AdgroupRequest define systemBiddingType with enum NONE/ML separately from bidAmt. Freeze NONE for fixed-CPC verification and compare it on readback; missing or ML mode remains unknown even when bidAmt matches. Documentation rechecked 2026-10-24; no live API calls.
CAMPAIGN_ENDED applies when today exceeds the end date, supporting an inclusive vendor calendar end. Exact mapping from OM TimeWindow remains unresolved; no writes.
AdRequest.userLock is documented for update, without explicit create support. Treat disabled TEXT_45 creation as UNVERIFIED; do not create enabled then pause.
The ad content example has headline/description and pc/mobile final/display links.

Single id supports daily timeIncrement=1, while bulk ids only supports allDays. The selected DailyStatResponse contains data, summary and optional cycleBaseTm; per-row dateStart/dateEnd are KST labels. salesAmt is VAT-inclusive integer KRW; impCnt/clkCnt/ccnt are integer counts. Canonical micros preserve exact JSON tokens. Purchase-only value is not a proxy for all conversions. cycleBaseTm timezone/cutoff semantics are unverified, so dataThrough=0, freshness=stale, finality=provisional.

Campaigns and campaign-filtered groups support NEXT/baseSearchId/recordSize pagination. Ads by nccAdgroupId are a non-paginated array. Customer and parent IDs must match. Status reads named campaigns and scoped group/ad evidence; DENIED and documented statusReason rejection codes retain child IDs. Campaign ELIGIBLE alone does not establish review approval. Missing campaigns or request exhaustion remain incomplete, retaining completed observations.

Each entity has contiguous half-open chunks of at most 92 inclusive vendor days. Every response summary/row is checked against its own chunk. Shared 100-request/5,000-row budget preserves completed chunks when exhausted. No canonical inner 15-second race.
round2B1.limitEvidence: Official stats schema documents KST dates but does not expose a numeric 92-day maximum. 92 days is the binding conservative bound from the review, not claimed as newly verified vendor documentation.
